Toolsman mengumpulkan pekerjaan kecil ya: Toolsman brings together the small jobs that come up during assignments: merging PDFs, shrinking images, drawing diagrams, cleaning up READMEs, and composing prompts. Everything runs in your browser without an account, except File Sharing, which needs a server so others can open the link.
Pekerjaan kecil sering tersebar di banya: Small tasks are often scattered across websites: one for merging PDFs, another for shrinking images, a third for diagrams. Each has its own size limits, sometimes asks you to register, and may upload your files to someone else's server.
Toolsman menyatukan pekerjaan itu di sat: Toolsman brings these jobs together with two rules: your files stay on your device, and you do not need to register. When a tool does need a server, its limits are stated clearly on its page, not hidden behind marketing copy.

Open it from Your transfers in the same browser to see download counts, enable notifications while the page is open, or select Delete now.
